title: Turtle Back Hall and Chris Kelly's seven-piece band
summary: The Turtle Back (Young Men) Hall, where Chris Kelly played, and the quality of his seven-piece band.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Listen, where was the Turtle Back Hall? Huh? Where was the Turtle Back Hall?
Turtle Back back, yeah. That was the Young Men Hall. That's setback on Elmire and Lamarck.
That's where Chris Kelly used to play most all the time.
What kind of band did he have?
Who, Chris Kelly? Yeah. Well he had about a seven piece band. Was it a good band?
Yeah, he had a good band.
He had a pretty good band. He had a pretty good band. Had good music? Probably you were talking about Mealy Balls. Yeah?
